choices.text: Show Manny and the customer, and write it up exactly as you found it.

response.text: During an oil change in Stockton, you notice the brake chambers on a customer's truck were installed with the wrong part. Another tech in the shop did that job last month. The customer only paid for an oil change today.
response.title: A brake job someone else did
